t: You are at the site of St Michael Wood Street, a church and parish of medieval origin in Cripplegate Ward. It is first mentioned in 1225, as St Michael de Wudestrate. The church stood on the west side of Wood Street. It first had its frontage on Huggin Lane, and later on Wood Street itself. Sir Christopher Wren is named as its designer. He is the architect of St Paul's Cathedral, and after the Great Fire of 1666 he was given responsibility for rebuilding many City churches.
